metadata.title: SSPP Template - DNS Secure Email
metadata.remarks: Normative SSPP template defining institutional DNS-based email security, identity, and transport governance. Includes DMARC, SPF, DKIM, transport security, monitoring, and workforce accountability aligned to NIST NICE.

import-profile.remarks: Imports institutional baseline security, privacy, and governance requirements.

system-characteristics.system-description: Central DNS-based email security and identity governance for all institutional email domains, covering mailbox delivery, campaign messaging, and notification gateways.

props.name: institutional-owner
props.remarks: Owns institutional email identity, reputation, sender legitimacy, and external representation.

props.name: technical-owner
props.remarks: Defines, enforces, and monitors DNS-based email security controls and risk posture.

props.name: governance-model
props.remarks: DNS-based email security is centrally governed. Delegation is limited, approved, auditable, and revocable.

props.name: domain-scope
props.remarks: All apex domains and subdomains owned, operated, or represented by the University are in scope, including non-sending domains.

props.name: non-sending-domain-policy
props.remarks: Domains not intended to send email MUST still publish DMARC policies to prevent spoofing and abuse.

props.name: primary-mailbox-pattern
props.remarks: Mailbox email delivery is governed through the secure-email pattern (e.g., Exchange Online).

props.name: campaign-email-pattern
props.remarks: Bulk and campaign email is governed through the Email Bulk Messaging Gateway pattern (e.g., Envoke).

props.name: notification-email-pattern
props.remarks: Automated notifications MUST use a dedicated sending subdomain governed through the Email Notification Gateway pattern.

props.name: dmarc-posture
props.remarks: DMARC MUST be enforced for all sending domains. Unauthorized senders must not pass DMARC evaluation.

props.name: dmarc-reporting
props.remarks: DMARC aggregate reporting MUST be enabled and actively monitored.

props.name: spf-governance
props.remarks: SPF records are centrally governed. Limited delegation is permitted only to the institutional email team and requires branding approval.

props.name: spf-lifecycle-management
props.remarks: All SPF entries MUST have ownership, review cadence, and documented retirement of obsolete senders.

props.name: dkim-requirement
props.remarks: All institutional sending platforms MUST authenticate using DKIM under centrally approved standards.

props.name: transport-security
props.remarks: MTA-STS MUST be enforced and TLS reporting (TLS-RPT) MUST be enabled and monitored.

props.name: future-capabilities
props.remarks: BIMI, ARC, and DANE are tracked for future adoption once prerequisites such as DNSSEC and mature DMARC deployment are met.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: DNS Secure Email assumes authoritative, resilient, and observable DNS behavior as asserted by the Secure-DNS platform SSPP.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP template defines governance, trust, and enforcement expectations. Platform-specific implementations are documented in SSPP instances and inherited platform SSPPs.

components.title: Central Email DNS Governance
components.description: Defines, enforces, and monitors DMARC, SPF, DKIM, and email transport security policies for institutional domains.

components.title: Delegated Email Sending Domains
components.description: Approved delegated subdomains used for campaign or notification email under formal governance controls.

components.title: Email DNS PKI Controls
components.description: DNS-based public key infrastructure governance for email-related certificates.

links.text: Depends on DNS Secure PKI (CAA) governance.

roles.title: DNS Secure Email Policy Authority
roles.remarks: Defines institutional DNS-based email security posture, delegation rules, and acceptable risk.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Executive Cyber Leadership per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

roles.title: DNS Secure Email Architect
roles.remarks: Designs DNS Secure Email architecture, trust boundaries, and enforcement patterns.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Architect per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: DNS Secure Email Operations
roles.remarks: Executes approved DNS email security changes and enforces centrally governed controls.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Systems Administrator per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: DNS Secure Email Monitoring and Assessment
roles.remarks: Monitors DMARC, SPF, DKIM, MTA-STS, and TLS-RPT telemetry and supports investigations and SARs.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Operations Analyst per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: Email Identity and Branding Governance
roles.remarks: Defines, approves, and protects institutional email identity, sender legitimacy, and external representation.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Executive Cyber Leadership per NIST NICE Framework.

control-implementation.remarks: Control satisfaction is demonstrated through existence of enforced DNS records (DMARC, SPF, DKIM, MTA-STS), active monitoring, and governance approval artifacts.
